steps: Bring both hands together in front of your chest with the fingertips touching.
Turn both hands so the palms face down while your fingers relax and loosen.
Drop your hands a few inches, as if something slipped out from between them.
Finish with open, relaxed hands and a neutral, matter-of-fact expression.
tip: Use this only for misplaced things, like lost keys — losing a game or competition is a different sign.

steps: Form both hands into O shapes, with each thumb touching its fingertips.
Hold the O hands out in front of you, palms facing each other and slightly forward.
Push both hands forward a few inches in one quick, smooth motion.
Shake your head no once as your hands move forward.
tip: You can sign this one-handed, but never drop the single headshake — it carries the whole meaning.

steps: Open your dominant hand into a loose five shape with the fingers spread.
Touch your chin with the thumb of that open hand.
Sweep the hand forward and slightly sideways in one or two small arches.
Angle your palm inward toward your face as the hand travels.
Lower your eyebrows a little, as if asking which option is preferred.
tip: Lifeprint glosses this sign PREFER — signing YOU PREFER PIZZA OR HAMBURGER? is how you ask 'Would you rather have pizza or a hamburger?'; some signers close the hand into an A as it moves.
